result.title: Guidance as Variance Matching
result.summary: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer to hand-crafted ones on SD 3.5 Medium. Third, we offer an interpretation of the mechanism behind guidance: each model makes a random error in predicting the posterior mean, and guidance rescales the difference of these errors into a sample with the posterior's covariance, which improves sampling. This view also suggests two new hypotheses that our experiments support: guidance can work with negative scales, and guiding a model with its own checkpoint needs a larger scale than guiding it with an independently trained model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 diffusion guidance 在实践中并未改善后验均值预测、反而使其变差，但能恢复预测方差的不足；据此提出 variance-matched guidance 的闭式规则，无需调参即可复现多个模型的手选引导尺度，并给出「误差差重标定」的机制解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 后验均值预测方差低于数据、引导重标定预测误差结构的分析，与 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的方差校准、表示信息坍缩诊断存在概念类比，可供核查其度量与解释思路能否迁移。
